editorial_flags: The CN metaphor in the opening monologue is rendered as a Russian paraphrase of the familiar 'what does not kill you makes you stronger' idea; retain the speaker's skeptical tone.
魔族 is rendered as «дьяволы» following EN Yostar, while 萨卡兹 remains «сарказы»; do not conflate the epithet with the race name.
The exact Russian rendering of 磐蟹 is kept generic as «краб» following EN Yostar; revisit if the creature's species term is established elsewhere.
CN line 105 uses 侯爵 (marquess), while EN Yostar says Count; «маркиз Борис» follows CN.
CN line 143 uses 伊比利亚修士 (Iberian monk), while EN Yostar says Iberian nun; «монах из Иберии» follows CN.
城邦地块 is rendered as «городская платформа» based on EN Yostar city plate; verify against the project's wider mobile-city terminology.
废城 is rendered as «разрушенный город» in the exchange about Patriot's fallback key; keep distinct from «город-спутник» unless wider context establishes equivalence.

The previous v2.02 next_source_line value 82 pointed to a Character command, not a text position. The next untranslated text after ordinal 40 is CN line 81; after this segment it is ordinal 81 at line 150.
CN line 150 uses 萨弗拉, the Savra race; Russian «савра» follows the established Russian race name.
CN line 176 says Talulah is unusually 善解人意 (considerate/accommodating), while EN Yostar paraphrases this as showing her cards early. Russian follows CN.
CN line 228 uses 龙女 without the profanity in EN Yostar's 'dragon bitch'; Russian follows CN.
CN lines 190 and 206 use Arts/Originium Arts; Russian «Искусства» follows docs/TERMS_RU.txt.
CN line 190 最纯粹的能量使用形式 is rendered «самая чистая форма применения энергии», retaining the source's meaning of the purest form of energy use.
CN line 272 uses the stylized phrase 可怜可憎的内敌; the Russian keeps the deliberately formal/hostile «жалкий и презренный внутренний враг», rather than EN's shortened 'You pitiful thing'.
CN line 347 explicitly says 施术 (to use/cast Arts) to detonate the explosives; Russian follows CN with «применила Искусства», while EN paraphrases this as having a detonator mechanism.
CN line 345 combines burning light, an intoxicating burnt smell and a hot wave full of fragments; the Russian keeps all three images without importing EN's 'light of destruction' paraphrase.
CN line 363 says 二十多遍 (more than twenty times), while EN Yostar says 'a million times'; Russian follows CN's explicit quantity.
CN line 378 says 你的计划 ('your plan'); EN Yostar adds 'backup plan'. Russian follows CN without adding the backup-plan implication.
CN line 384 specifies being thrown from the core city (核心城); EN Yostar changes this to city walls. Russian follows CN.
CN line 406 says 我该把自己也变成炸弹 ('I should turn myself into a bomb'); EN Yostar paraphrases this as 'blow this joint'. Russian follows CN.
CN line 367 uses a deliberately comic image of a badly timed muffled fart in trousers; the Russian retains the image in W's inner monologue.

CN line 238 有劳你了 is an expression of entrusting the task/acknowledging the other person's effort; EN Yostar says 'Excuse me, Sir'. Russian «Рассчитываю на вас, господин» follows CN and the scene context.
CN lines 465–466 state that since Talulah has already started the core city, Patriot asks what use his key has. EN Yostar rewrites the exchange; Russian follows CN.
The timestamp at CN line 424 is a post-battle marker: 31 hours until Chernobog's impact, 6:30 P.M. Russian uses «18:30».
Patriot's fragmented syntax is preserved in lines 206, 212, 215–216, 218–219, 224, 226–227 and 229–230; this is an intentional characterization choice, subject to literary review.
CN line 511 says the talisman can sustain the holder's life; EN Yostar paraphrases this as keeping the holder safe. Russian follows CN.
CN line 544 says the Sarkaz will no longer be needed as leaders; EN Yostar changes this to no longer bowing before a Sarkaz. Russian follows CN.
CN line 553 explicitly includes newly made ruins and the remaking of steel; EN Yostar recasts and compresses the imagery. Russian follows CN.
凛冽的声音 and 沙哑的声音 are rendered as «Леденящий голос» and «Хриплый голос». The source leaves the speakers anonymous; no identities are inferred.
流浪的魔族 is rendered as «странствующие демоны» and remains an epithet, distinct from the Sarkaz race name.
The 7-1 Interlude is complete at 286/286 positions and 276/276 command positions. Literary review and Yostar Global PC in-game validation remain pending.
note: CN-primary complete first draft, positions 1–286 of 286. CN/EN align on all 286 text positions and 276 command positions. All source commands are preserved. Thirteen lexical/meaning differences are documented and resolved in favor of CN. The scene is complete as a first draft; it has not been tested in the game client.
